title: Brand tempo: calm and static against punchy and drifting
caption: The s01 cinematic title rendered twice from the same scene plan, with only motion_preferences in brand.json changed: tempo calm with a static camera on the left, tempo punchy with the recipe's camera drift on the right. The HyperFrames animation reads both settings frame by frame.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to show the client how the brand motion settings change a film. Take the cinematic title from showcase/s01-cinematic-title and render it twice with HyperFrames: once with motion_preferences.tempo "calm" and camera_style "static" (calm/), once with tempo "punchy" and camera_style "subtle_drift" (punchy/). Change nothing else. Put the two renders side by side with mgvideo multicam and label each half with its settings in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg).
commands: mgvideo multicam work/calm.mp4 work/punchy.mp4 --layout side-by-side -o work/side-by-side.mp4
ffmpeg -i work/side-by-side.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -an -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/tempo.mp4
